environment: Ubuntu 24.04.1 under WSL 2, Node 22.23.3, Playwright 1.56.0, WebKit 26.0
method: In a scratch clone, test/unit/audio-tolerances.js was given a WebKit value for every metric, copied from another engine (.github/ci-exploration/webkit-trial.mjs on the ci-exploration branch). The 8 WebKit render suites then ran with PI_AUDIO_ENGINES=webkit and PI_AUDIO_CALIBRATE=1. The tolerance file in the repository was not changed.
mixDeterminism: Passes at Firefox's value of 0, so WebKit multi-voice mixes are bit-identical across page loads

calibration.note: Printed by audio-reference-browser.test.js; residuals normalized by the fixture's reference peak

conclusion: Linux WebKit renders match Chromium's precision. Chromium's recorded tolerances fit every WebKit test, with the same separation between valid fades and abrupt clicks.
